vector_set: Canonical NDC v2 Profile 1 — adversarial lineage, coverage and rights descriptions
authority: WS-NDC-2026-11-24-003 digest 417bd4e5e9904d21d2da5905b3ac68905d677f800526eeedcf25fab897ce2119; Profile 1 Decisions D, E and 003 §§8–10
note: All identifiers and instants are abstract. No right is granted and no dataset acceptance is recorded by these examples.

cases.cycle_condition: the trusted predecessor chain returns to release-example
cases.rule: Cycles, self-reference and a release supplying its own predecessor are rejected.
Denominator is required and non-zero; there is no PASS without a declared denominator.
Rights evidence fails closed when absent or unresolved; a signature or receipt grants no right.

cases.predecessor_condition: no trusted predecessor evidence is available outside the release
cases.rule: A corrected release has one immediate predecessor resolved from outside the release.
The immediate predecessor revision is strictly less than the current revision; chain traversal decrements by one.
Knowledge time at or before the release as-of is required; future knowledge time fails closed.
invalidated_at_time is a canonical UTC string with Z, exactly nine fractional digits, no offset form and a valid calendar instant.
Evidence cannot be reassigned; every performed operation resolves exactly one matching evidence record.
Venue-less sources are outside Profile 1; a null or placeholder venue is not an unspecified value.
